1512601.name: Leg Laser
1512601.description:
Fires lasers from back legs, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
The back legs can be destroyed.

1512603.name: Squid Missile
1512603.description:
Fires many Squid Missiles at a single Nikke, dealing damage.
Missiles can be intercepted.

1512604.name: Discharge
1512604.description:
Kraken releases electromagnetic waves using its front leg, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
The front leg can be destroyed.

1512606.name: Super Discharge
1512606.description:
Kraken releases electromagnetic waves using its two front legs, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
The front legs can be destroyed.

1512607.name: Focus Laser
1512607.description: Fires a laser, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

1512608.name: Hyper Discharge
1512608.description: Kraken gathers energy and unleashes it, dealing damage to all Nikkes. Any Nikkes who are hit will be rendered temporarily unable to act.

1512609.name: Vertical Screw
1512609.description:
Stirs up a whirlwind, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Kraken generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while using Vertical Screw. While the barrier is up, only Water Code Nikkes can deal damage.

1512610.name: Tidal Wave
1512610.description: Kraken stirs up massive waves, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
